_README: TEMPLATE ONLY -- copy this OUTSIDE the project folder, fill it in there, and never
save real credentials back into this directory.
IMPORTANT: 'rev' must go UP every time you change these credentials. That number is
what makes a new build's credentials supersede whatever an existing customer install
already has. The embed script refuses to run if you forget.
IMPORTANT: use a DEDICATED relay account, not a personal mailbox. These credentials
ship inside the customer's exe obfuscated, not encrypted -- anyone holding the
installer can recover them, and a Gmail app password grants full IMAP read of the
whole mailbox, not just outbound send.
smtp_port 465 = implicit SSL (Gmail). 587 = STARTTLS. Both are supported.
For Gmail the password is a 16-character App Password (Google Account > Security >
2-Step Verification > App passwords), with the spaces removed -- not the account
